quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #6
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 14

questions.question: What do orange signs mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs are used in work zones on highways. They are diamond-shaped with black letters or symbols. They warn drivers that workers are on or near the road.

questions.question: You can pass safely on a two-way, two-lane street only if:

options.text: You can clearly see the road ahead.
You can return to your lane before meeting oncoming traffic.
Your vehicle is fast enough to pass.

questions.explanation: Safe passing requires three things: you can see the road ahead, you can return to your lane before meeting oncoming cars, and your vehicle is fast enough to pass. Never pass where it is illegal or unsafe.

questions.question: If you are already in an intersection when a green light turns yellow, you should:

options.text: Continue and clear the intersection safely.
Speed up to avoid causing an accident.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue and clear the intersection safely.
questions.explanation: If you are already in an intersection when the light turns yellow, continue through and leave the intersection as quickly as you can.

questions.question: If an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches you on a one-way street, you must:

options.text: Move to the side of the road and stop.
Speed up and take the nearest exit.
Slow down and let the vehicle pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the side of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches on a one-way street, move to the nearest side of the road and stop.

questions.question: In fog or mist, why should you not use your high beam headlights?

options.text: The light reflects back into your eyes.
Other drivers might not see you.
Cars behind you may follow too closely.

questions.correctAnswerText: The light reflects back into your eyes.
questions.explanation: In fog or mist, high beam headlights reflect the light back toward your eyes, making it harder to see.

questions.question: When driving in fog, you should:

options.text: Slow down and use your low beam headlights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and use your low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: In fog, slow down and use low beam lights. If the fog is too thick to see, pull off the road and wait for it to clear.

questions.question: What can happen if you drive under the influence of alcohol or drugs?
questions.explanation: Driving under the influence can result in fines, jail time, and suspension or revocation of your license.

questions.question: Which sign is rectangular in shape?
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs are rectangular with white backgrounds and black lettering. They show rules about speed and other regulations.

questions.question: A large truck ahead is turning right onto a street with two lanes in each direction. What may happen?

options.text: It may use either of the two lanes.
It may need to swing wide to turn right.
It must stay in the right lane while turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: It may need to swing wide to turn right.
questions.explanation: Large trucks need extra space to turn because their rear wheels follow a shorter path than their front wheels. The longer the vehicle, the more it must swing wide to complete a right turn.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow traffic light mean?
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light tells you to drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. At this location, railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottoms of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: You approach a railroad crossing with no gates or flashing lights, but it has a crossbuck sign. What should you do?

options.text: Approach with extreme caution. Cross only when you are sure no train is coming.
Turn your radio down to listen for an approaching train.
Only continue when a flagger tells you it is safe to cross.

questions.explanation: Always approach railroad crossings with extreme caution. Cross only when you are sure no train is coming from either direction. If a flagger is present, follow all their instructions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: When is highway pavement most slippery?

options.text: After it has been raining for several hours.
When it just starts to rain.
After it has been raining for one to two hours.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it just starts to rain.
questions.explanation: Pavement is most slippery when rain first begins. Dirt and oil on the road mix with rainwater, creating a slick layer.

questions.question: On a New York State highway with no posted speed limit, what is the fastest you can legally drive?
questions.explanation: On a state highway with no posted speed limit, the legal maximum speed is 55 mph.

questions.question: Like alcohol and other drugs, drowsiness can:

options.text: Help you be a better driver.

questions.explanation: Not getting enough sleep causes poor driving. Like drugs and alcohol, drowsiness slows your reaction time, reduces awareness, and weakens judgment.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: You can pass from the lane with the solid yellow line.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.
You can pass from the lane with the broken yellow line.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass from the lane with the broken yellow line.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means traffic on the broken line side can pass. Traffic on the solid line side cannot pass.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means a ____ light will appear soon.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a steady red light will appear next.

questions.question: You must not drive faster than:

options.text: A speed that is reasonable and safe.
A speed that is safe for current conditions.

questions.explanation: You must not drive faster than what is reasonable and safe. Adjust your speed based on traffic, pedestrians, weather, road condition, and light. Always obey posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic merging from the right.
